assumptions: The filters and record cap given.
limits: Capped at the record limit; reads beyond it are counted, not returned.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which reads, what depth and what pairing does this window of the BAM or SAM hold?

description: Read one window of a BAM or SAM in this project: its reads, the depth across it, and what the pairs say about the library — the same window, filters and record cap the pileup draws. Wire `reads` into an alignment or a screen the way the pane's own hand-offs do.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alignment.description: which BAM or SAM in this project, by name. Unset, it is the project's only alignment — and it refuses rather than guessing when there is more than one.

hide_duplicates.description: drop reads marked as PCR or optical duplicates (FLAG 0x400).

locus.description: the window, as a locus string (`ctgA:1-50,001`). Unset, it is the whole of the alignment's first reference — the window the panel opens on.

max_reads.description: the record cap. More reads than this overlap the window and the result is an even SAMPLE of them, with `sampled` saying so — the pane’s own cap is the default.

min_mapq.description: hide reads below this mapping quality, as the pane’s Filter reads operation does. The reads are still counted — `hidden` says how many this removed.

name: alignment_window

coverage.description: the depth profile as bins across the window, in order

depthPlot.description: the coverage track as the pileup draws it: each bin's lowest, mean and highest per-base depth over ALL reads, so a dropout narrower than a bin still shows in the minimum

depth_mean.description: mean depth across the window’s coverage bins, over ALL reads — the coverage track is full-depth, as BamView’s is, so filters do not move it

hidden.description: reads in the window the filters removed — 0 with an active filter is a real answer

insert_size.description: the |TLEN| band this library’s own proper pairs define — `min`, `max` and whether it was MEASURED here or is the untuned fallback, which is what decides whether an insert is abnormal

reads.description: the reads in the window after filters: name, reference, 1-based start and end, strand, MAPQ, CIGAR, TLEN and sequence — the shape an alignment or a screen takes

sampled.description: more reads overlap the window than the cap allows, so `reads` is an even sample rather than all of them

window.description: the window actually read, as a locus string
